name: Energy-Mission Machineries (India) Ltd.
summary: Energy-Mission Machineries (India) Ltd. operates within the industrial machinery sector, specializing in the design and manufacturing of metal-forming machines for various industrial applications. The company's primary products include hydraulic shearing machines, NC and CNC hydraulic press brakes, plate rolling machines, hydraulic ironworkers, deep drawing presses, busbar processing machines, and V-grooving machines. These machines range from conventional hydraulic models to advanced CNC-controlled systems. Energy-Mission Machineries serves diverse sectors such as automotive, steel, infrastructure, agriculture, and general engineering and fabrication industries. The company operates on a business-to-business (B2B) model, providing both standard and custom-engineered solutions. While primarily focused on the domestic Indian market, the company also exports its products to over 25 countries, including those in the USA, Europe, the Middle East, and Australia. The company emphasizes precision engineering solutions, contributing to import substitution efforts under the "Make in India" initiative, and focuses on integrating energy-efficient hydraulic systems and CNC technologies into its machinery.
